meta.description: Elite Dangerous engineers reference data (locations, invite/unlock requirements, referral, specialties). Journal EngineerProgress gives progress only; this file supplies the rest.
sources: EDDiscovery EliteDangerousCore Engineers.cs (Apache License 2.0, coordinates and requirements cross-check): https://github.com/EDDiscovery/EliteDangerousCore/blob/master/EliteDangerous/FrontierData/Items/Engineers.cs
EDEngineer blueprints.json (MIT License, grade cross-check): https://github.com/msarilar/EDEngineer
ED Odyssey Materials Helper locale CSV (on-foot requirement text cross-check): https://github.com/jixxed/ed-odyssey-materials-helper
meta.matching: Match journal EngineerProgress entries by engineer name (case-insensitive). EngineerID is not stored here.
meta.notes: Where sources disagreed, the value used and the alternative are written in each entry's notes. Regenerate after game updates that move or add engineers. namesJa: Japanese katakana spellings for voice matching (no official Japanese client; Claude-written, several variants per name; not from the sources above).

engineers.name: Felicity Farseer
namesJa: フェリシティ・ファーシーア
フェリシティ・ファーシア
engineers.invite: Gain exploration rank Scout or higher
engineers.unlock: Provide 1 unit of Meta-Alloys
engineers.notes: Discovery: public knowledge (INARA: 'Public data sources'). Refers Juri Ishmaak.

engineers.name: Elvira Martuuk
namesJa: エルビラ・マルトゥーク
エルヴィラ・マートゥーク
エルビラ・マートゥーク
engineers.invite: Attain a maximum distance from your career start location of at least 300 light years
engineers.unlock: Provide 3 units of Soontill Relics
engineers.notes: Discovery: public knowledge. Refers Marco Qwent, Zacariah Nemo and Mel Brandon (Colonia).

engineers.name: The Dweller
engineers.invite: Deal with at least 5 black markets
engineers.unlock: Pay 500,000 credits
engineers.notes: Discovery: common knowledge. Refers Lei Cheung and Marsha Hicks (Colonia).

engineers.name: Tod 'The Blaster' McQuinn
engineers.invite: Earn more than 15 bounty vouchers
engineers.unlock: Provide 100,000 credits worth of bounty vouchers
engineers.notes: Discovery: common knowledge. Journal/EDDiscovery spelling uses single quotes: Tod 'The Blaster' McQuinn (INARA displays double quotes). Fandom states 100,001 CR of vouchers. Refers Selene Jean and Petra Olmanova (Colonia).

engineers.name: Liz Ryder
engineers.invite: Gain Cordial or Friendly status with Eurybia Blue Mafia
engineers.unlock: Provide 200 units of Landmines
engineers.notes: Discovery: public sources. Fandom says Friendly with Eurybia Blue Mafia (INARA/EDDiscovery/Black Box: Cordial or Friendly). Makalu is the body name in Eurybia. Refers Hera Tani and Etienne Dorn (Colonia).

namesJa: ジュリ・イシュマーク
ユーリ・イシュマーク

engineers.notes: Referred by Felicity Farseer at grade 3-4 reputation. Refers The Sarge and Colonel Bris Dekker.

engineers.unlock: Provide 25 units of Sensor Fragments
